annotations.title: Apply an exact backfill preview using saved settings

description: Apply an exact backfill preview using saved settings. Queue unanswered conversations and fresh investigations of qualifying pending plans, up to 100 items. Enabled assistants may reply; new plans follow saved auto-run settings. Skips paused, active, failed or uncertain work. Does not replay old executions. Requires the exact preview_hash; changed settings or work require a new preview. Repeating a successful hash returns its saved receipt.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change
